senses.gloss:
इन a.
1 Able, strong, powerful,
mighty.
--2 Bold, determined.
--3
Glorious.
--नः
1 A lord, master.
--2 The sun; Śi. 2. 65.
--3 A king;
न न महीनमहीनपराक्रमं R. 9. 5.
--4
The lunar mansion Hasta.
--Comp.
--कांतः sunstone (सूर्यकांत); Bh. 2. 37.
--सभं a royal court or assembly.

इनक्षति (Desid. of नक्ष्) Ved. To
try to reach, strive to get.
